title: Tiger Bill: El Negro Hernandez at Modern Drummer Festival 1997 (video review)
notes: 'Our Family' opens with his trademark left-foot clave; on 'Rumbatella' he switches between left-foot clave and left-foot bass drum.

title: Tiger Bill: review of Conversations in Clave (Horacio Hernandez)
notes: The book introduces three- and four-limb ostinato patterns; clave in the right hand with the hi-hat foot on the downbeat.
